notes.title: Answers to questions about doors that don't open
notes.content:
Answers to questions about doors that don't open

I'm very sorry for everyone, because the interface is relatively hidden, in fact, the first task has instructions, you need to find a key to open the door. Maybe everyone didn't see the task at first. It is our guidance that is not done well enough. There is a key in the window to the right of the door. You can open the door by holding it. Have a good time, everyone.
